title: Zscaler AI Scanning Platform Licensing and Fair Use

blocks.text: Zscaler AI Scanning Platform is a Software as a Service (SaaS) product that is licensed based on a platform subscription fee and the number of Probe Units purchased for the subscription term in an order.
A Probe Unit is the standard non-divisible metric of consumption on the AI Scanning Platform. Probe Units come in the following two types:

blocks.item: Standard Probe: A single discrete analysis function executed by the AI Scanning Platform on an AI system.

Large Probe: A single discrete analysis function executed by the AI Scanning Platform which exceeds 200 test cases. The number of test cases is based on configurations defined in custom datasets, custom probes, RAG Precision scans, or Q&A scans.

blocks.text: A Scanner Run is a bundled simultaneous execution on an AI system of multiple distinct Standard Probes or Large Probes. Probe Units are consumed when you execute a Standard Probe, Large Probe, or a Scanner Run. You decide which Probes or Scanners to run and at what frequency via the Admin Portal.

Ensure that you order the correct number of Probe Units for your AI system, model, or application requirements. If you require additional Probe Units, contact Zscaler Sales or your Channel Partner. Zscaler periodically reviews the number of Probe Units consumed to ensure license compliance.
The usage of AI Scanning Platform is expected to be in accordance with the Acceptable Use Policy.
